summary: Add staged, on-device renewal for saved iPhone profiles and a local device-renewal staging command.

replay.detail: No existing history is rewritten or rebuilt.

schema.detail: Adds renewal stage, challenge and completion records within the existing client pairing namespace, using native client operation receipts.

compatibility.detail: Adds client renewal routes and the devices renew-stage command. Existing manual pairing remains available. On-device approval requires an iOS build with the updated native key module; older builds do not offer this flow.

downtime.detail: No startup migration or scheduled downtime.

manual.detail: An operator stages a replacement for an existing profile; the phone presents its member, person and scopes for approval. Completion atomically retires the source credential while issuing the replacement. A lost completion response or failed phone save requires a fresh operator-staged replacement.

recovery.detail: Renewal explicitly supports expired or short-lived source grants selected by audited digest. The stage fixes a replacement expiry at 30 days after staging, bound by the signed offer and phone approval and preserved exactly at completion. Uncompleted stages expire automatically. A failed approval retains the previous saved phone profile.
